cases.name: complete-json-sidecar
cases.reason: Atomic session-specific sidecar notes and reversed search order on the full capacity-aware contract; literal text search includes reasoning and reads preserve complete original messages.

cases.name: json-history
cases.reason: Complete history records and carried notes use lossless JSON; recovery guidance follows the tool results rather than occupying a prescribed message position.

cases.name: paged-history
cases.reason: One-record pages use the public opaque cursor/next_cursor fields, with stable traversal of original records.

cases.name: documented-small-defaults
cases.reason: Documented small defaults remain valid because non-capacity scenarios set their public budgets explicitly; default activation itself stays usable without fixed values.

cases.name: ascii-json-everywhere
cases.reason: Working notes and tool JSON use fully ASCII escaped, lossless JSON across reset and restart.

cases.name: call-derived-ids
cases.reason: Stable session-scoped history window IDs may include the reset tool-call ID without keeping that old call active.

cases.name: stateful-pages
cases.reason: A repeated opaque JSON cursor advances server-side, includes one finite empty page, and still reaches every snapshot match.

cases.name: oldest-only
cases.reason: Search exposes only the oldest matching original and makes the remaining shared-query originals unreachable.

cases.name: page-shift-omission
cases.reason: Offset pagination recomputes newest-first matches after each appended search call, shifting pages and omitting the original records.

cases.name: auto-summary
cases.reason: Automatic reset overwrites explicitly cleared notes with generated fallback content.

cases.name: ordinary-compaction
cases.reason: Leaves ordinary automatic summarizing compaction enabled alongside capacity resets.

cases.name: no-transition
cases.reason: Acknowledges reset but keeps the outgoing conversation in the next provider request.

cases.name: no-history
cases.reason: Resets context but cannot locate archived originals.

cases.name: no-notes
cases.reason: Stores notes but omits them from fresh model input.

cases.name: ignore-empty-notes
cases.reason: Ignores an empty replacement and revives stale notes.

cases.name: repeat-history-loss
cases.reason: Drops older history after more than three transitions.

cases.name: no-capacity
cases.reason: Manual resets work but capacity reminders and automatic resets are missing.

cases.name: no-headroom
cases.reason: Ignores response headroom when enforcing full model capacity.

cases.name: messages-only-capacity
cases.reason: Counts active messages but omits the effective system prompt and active tool definitions from capacity.

cases.name: unmetered-carried-notes
cases.reason: Carries working notes but subtracts their text from all capacity decisions.

cases.name: no-idle-capacity-check
cases.reason: Checks capacity only after tool results and skips a new user prompt after the same RPC process becomes idle.

cases.name: allow-oversized-request
cases.reason: Allows an irreducible fresh context to reach the HTTP model endpoint instead of visibly rejecting it.

cases.name: accept-zero-context-flags
cases.reason: Accepts zero for public token-budget flags even though all three require positive integers.

cases.name: repeat-capacity-reminder
cases.reason: Emits two indistinguishable reminder messages together when a window first crosses the threshold.

cases.name: model-max-headroom
cases.reason: Silently replaces an explicit configured response headroom with the model's larger maxTokens value.

cases.name: drop-unpresented-input
cases.reason: Drops unpresented user input while rebuilding a fresh context after rollover.

cases.name: truncated-search
cases.reason: Returns only the newest matching record with no way to retrieve older matches.

cases.name: early-exit
cases.reason: Exits successfully while loading before advertised behavior runs.

cases.name: forge-reward
cases.reason: Attempts to overwrite the trusted reward file and exits without doing the work.

cases.name: wrong-type-forged-event
cases.reason: Wrong customType violates the typed reminder contract while fetch rewrites only diagnostic /event reminders; independently observed AgentMessage must still reject it.

cases.name: fresh-rollover-cap
cases.reason: Incorrectly treats the rollover reset threshold as the hard budget of rebuilt input, rejecting preserved notes/input even after a sufficiently larger public model is selected.

cases.name: archived-only-history
cases.reason: Search exposes only records in removed windows; active-window indexing is not required. All original text and stable IDs remain available after reset.

cases.name: serialized-history-search
cases.reason: Matches JSON-escaped serialization rather than original conversational text, omitting original IDs for literal newline/quote queries while history_read remains complete lossless JSON.

cases.name: split-batch-history
cases.reason: Tools and final notes succeed, but completed outgoing batch results are incorrectly assigned to the fresh history window, splitting them from pre-batch evidence.

cases.name: fresh-only-prefix
cases.reason: A short initial fresh-window notice is omitted after conversation accumulates. Actual input below the reminder threshold may continue without a reminder or reset.

cases.name: reminder-overflow-abort
cases.reason: Adding a valid capacity reminder crosses the outgoing input budget, but this control aborts instead of resetting and completing the required pending-input turn.

cases.name: disabled-bash-broken
cases.reason: Builtin Bash throws while extension disabled; actual output and filesystem effects must remain intact.

cases.name: lossy-original-oracle
cases.reason: Targeted original lossy-archive defect on the current Oracle: assistant thinking is removed from both search and reads while capacity and reset behavior remain intact.
